decisions.reason: The single mobile slow-speed shredder is close to the core offer and probably meets aspirations, but the new multi-model slow-speed shredder line launched in 2024 could absorb it, which raises the risk of consolidation.

As the flagship modular plant line central to the firm's strategic direction, its still-uncertain results are carried by the slack of a growing firm rather than cut, especially after the related concept A was already pruned.
The mobile trommel screen extends an established product category at low incremental risk, and there is no signal of performance below aspiration that would trigger problemistic search.
The newly launched slow-speed shredder line has its own page and sits squarely in the core business, so it is too early and too well aligned for withdrawal.
The spiral shaft screen line has only just launched, builds on established competences and broadens the modular screening offer, so the firm will give it time to reach its aspiration level.
